change_summary: Add a concise 'confirm-then-execute in a single round' rule to consolidate multiple confirmations into one message.
reason_for_change: Transcripts 91, 99, 103 show 3-5 separate confirmation round-trips inflating mean turns/task (27.3). Instructing the agent to gather all lookups and confirm the full plan in one consolidated message cuts redundant turns, lowering mean cost per task without altering tool behavior or reducing success.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.047292 >= threshold 0.045669 (best mean 0.047950 - 1σ·0.002281)
hypothesis: The system prompt lacks guidance to batch all order lookups from a single get_order_details-per-order pass and to confirm the full plan in ONE consolidated message; adding a concise 'confirm-then-execute in a single round' rule (distinct from the rejected verbose efficiency guidelines) will cut redundant confirmation turns without changing tool behavior.
